name: mcp-agensgraph-cypher
description: Execute read and write Cypher queries on your Agensgraph database.
long_description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides tools for interacting with Agensgraph database using Cypher queries. Supports both read and write operations with proper validation and error handling.

tools.name: get_agensgraph_schema
tools.description: What is in the graph: one entry per node label, with its exact node count, its properties, and the relationship types leaving it

tools.name: read_agensgraph_cypher
tools.description: Run a read Cypher query in a read-only transaction, one page at a time, with params bound as %(name)s

tools.name: explain_agensgraph_cypher
tools.description: Show how AgensGraph would run a Cypher statement, optionally executing it for real timings inside a read-only transaction

tools.name: recommend_property_indexes
tools.description: Suggest property indexes and rewrites for a query, from its plan and the label catalogs; it never runs the DDL it reports

tools.name: agensgraph_health
tools.description: Cache hit ratio, unused indexes, vacuum backlog, connection use, auto_gather_graphmeta, and which optional extensions are installed

tools.name: top_cypher_queries
tools.description: The Cypher statements costing the most total time, from pg_stat_statements

tools.name: write_agensgraph_cypher
tools.description: Run an updating Cypher query and report the five write counters; withheld when the server runs read-only

agensgraph_url.title: AgensGraph URL
agensgraph_url.description: Where the database is, as a connection URL. Everything it carries is kept, including sslmode.

agensgraph_database.title: AgensGraph Database
agensgraph_database.description: The name of the AgensGraph database to connect to

agensgraph_username.title: AgensGraph Username
agensgraph_username.description: The username for connecting to the AgensGraph database

agensgraph_password.title: AgensGraph Password
agensgraph_password.description: Left empty, libpq resolves it: PGPASSWORD, .pgpass, PGSERVICE, or an authentication method that needs none.

agensgraph_graphname.title: AgensGraph Graph Name
agensgraph_graphname.description: The name of the graph in the AgensGraph database

agensgraph_namespace.title: Namespace
agensgraph_namespace.description: An optional namespace for the MCP server tools

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Withhold the write tool. The six remaining tools run their statements in a read-only transaction, and the graph is not created if it is missing.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: The MCP transport, defaults to stdio

mcp_server_host.title: MCP Server Host
mcp_server_host.description: The host for the MCP server, if not using stdio. Defaults to 127.0.0.1

mcp_server_port.title: MCP Server Port
mcp_server_port.description: The port for the MCP server, if not using stdio. Defaults to 8000
